# Timescale — Style Reference

> Halftone machine-room photographs on zinc paper, with one lime gauge needle. Geist at 700 and 600 on #ffffff, #e4e4e7 hairlines, uppercase mono annotations, and acid lime #f1ff5c spent only where a number deserves a reading.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Timescale speaks a halftone-instrument-panel language: an industrial database brochure printed in zinc ink and annotated like a lab notebook. The canvas is Paper Canvas #ffffff. Fog Panel #f4f4f5 bands the partner section, Onyx Panel #101013 inverts the testimonial block, Carbon Panel #1a1a1d forms trays on dark ground, and Jet Glass #0a0a0c99 strips sit over photographs. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue. Acid lime appears as Signal Lime #f1ff5c for fills and Keylime Readout #f4ff7d for text, and it is permitted only on metrics, quote marks and named customers inside dark sections. Everything else is a zinc ramp from Ink #000000 to Mist Hairline #e4e4e7. Typography is Geist Sans at 700 for the 80px display and at 600 for 52px and 22px headings, tightened to -0.03em and -0.01em respectively, on a steep scale of roughly 1.5 per step. Geist Mono 500 in uppercase carries every eyebrow and label. Shape is soft-sharp, with 4px controls and 8px frames, and elevation is tonal rather than shadowed. The site reads as an engineering logbook rather than a SaaS landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page ground, secondary button fill, input fill and the light chamfered card (17 background uses) — a pure white that lets the halftone photography supply all the texture. |
| Fog Panel | `#f4f4f5` | `--color-fog-panel` | Partner-section band, stat tiles and quiet inset blocks (6 uses) — a single tonal step below white that separates chapters without drawing a line. |
| Carbon Panel | `#1a1a1d` | `--color-carbon-panel` | Logo tray on the dark testimonial section, the hero photo frame and stat tiles (11 uses) — the lifted surface on dark ground, doing the job a shadow does elsewhere. |
| Onyx Panel | `#101013` | `--color-onyx-panel` | The "In the wild" testimonial section, the Enterprise card and the h2/h3 ink (9 text uses) — the inverted chapter colour, one step warmer than pure black. |
| Jet Glass | `#0a0a0c99` | `--color-jet-glass` | Stat strip laid over the hero photograph and image overlays — 60% Jet Ink that keeps the halftone texture visible behind the numbers. |
| Ink | `#000000` | `--color-ink` | Body copy, nav dropdown titles, partner headings and footer links (71 uses, the most frequent text colour) — the workhorse reading ink. |
| Jet Ink | `#0a0a0c` | `--color-jet-ink` | Primary button fill, the h1 display, nav links and input text (24 text uses plus 6 fills) — the system's only action colour, which is a near-black. Do not swap it for lime on light surfaces. |
| Slate Caption | `#71717a` | `--color-slate-caption` | Mega-menu descriptions, card sub-lines and secondary metadata (4 uses) — the secondary text step that keeps descriptions subordinate without going faint. |
| Ash Rule | `#a1a1aa` | `--color-ash-rule` | Input borders, the de-emphasised half of quotes on dark ground and tertiary labels (8 uses) — it does double duty as a line and as quiet text. |
| Mist Hairline | `#e4e4e7` | `--color-mist-hairline` | Feature-list dividers, mega-menu column rules and light-on-dark labels (17 background uses as 1px rules) — the most common line in the system. |
| Pewter Border | `#ccccd5` | `--color-pewter-border` | Secondary button outline, the chamfered card edge and the logo-row separators (8 border uses) — a cool, slightly violet grey that outlines controls without competing with ink. |
| Signal Lime | `#f1ff5c` | `--color-signal-lime` | Metric ticket fill, its outline frame and the testimonial quote mark — the single saturated hue, rationed to measured results. Do not promote it to the primary CTA colour. |
| Keylime Readout | `#f4ff7d` | `--color-keylime-readout` | Stat-strip numbers ("3 TRILLION") and the customer-name link inside the testimonial (3 uses) — the text-weight version of the accent, legible on #101013. Keep it off white surfaces, where it fails contrast. |

## Tokens — Typography

### GeistSans — the display, heading and interface voice, heavy at the top and plain below · `--font-geist-sans`
- **Substitute:** Geist at 400/500/600/700 (it is open source and matches exactly), Inter at 400/500/600/700 with Inter Display at 700 for the 80px display, Manrope at 500 for body and 700 for headings. Geist renders true to its nominal weight, so match numbers one-to-one. Inter at 600 draws marginally heavier, so step 22px headings down to 590 where variable axes allow.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px, 22px, 32px, 44px, 52px, 80px
- **Line height:** 1.1 (52px, 80px), 1.2 (32px), 1.25 (44px), 1.5 (14px to 22px)
- **Letter spacing:** -2.4px at 80px, -1.56px at 52px, -0.32px at 32px, -0.22px at 22px, -0.16px at 16px emphasised labels, normal elsewhere
- **Role:** Geist does all the talking, but it shifts register by weight. The 80px display at 700 and 52px headings at 600 are dense, tightly tracked at -0.03em, and read as stamped equipment plates. Below 22px the face relaxes to 400 at 1.5 leading. The only 400-weight display moment is the 44px testimonial, deliberately quiet because it is someone else's voice. Steps run 16 to 22 to 32 to 52 to 80, roughly 1.4 to 1.6 per step. That is far steeper than the conventional Perfect Fourth (1.333), so size rather than colour carries hierarchy.

### GeistMono — the annotation layer: eyebrows, labels, stats and tags · `--font-geist-mono`
- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 500, JetBrains Mono at 500, IBM Plex Mono at 500. Geist Mono 500 is compact and slightly heavy for a mono. Plex Mono at 400 reads too thin, so hold all substitutes at 500.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 15px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (12px), 1.4 (15px labels), 1.5 (15px and 14px list headers)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.24px at 12px, 0.3px at 15px (both 0.02em), normal on footer and menu headers
- **Role:** Mono runs exclusively in uppercase at a single weight, with "//" comment prefixes ("// PRIMITIVES", "// IN THE WILD"). It turns section labels into code comments. The +0.02em tracking opens the caps just enough to read as instrument stencil rather than terminal output. Mono is never used for body copy. It annotates, and the sans speaks.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | GeistMono | 500 | 12px | 1.0 | 0.24px | `--text-small` |
| caption | GeistMono | 500 | 15px | 1.4 | 0.3px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | GeistSans | 400 | 15px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | GeistSans | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | GeistSans | 400 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | GeistSans | 600 | 22px | 1.5 | -0.22px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | GeistSans | 600 | 32px | 1.2 | -0.32px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | GeistSans | 400 | 44px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | GeistSans | 600 | 52px | 1.1 | -1.56px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | GeistSans | 700 | 80px | 1.1 | -2.4px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep every action button on Jet Ink #0a0a0c or Paper Canvas #ffffff with a 1px #ccccd5 outline at 4px radius — the action is defined by ink density, not hue.
- Set the display at GeistSans 700, 80px, -2.4px tracking and 1.1 leading — the tightened heavy plate is what makes a near-monochrome page feel engineered.
- Spend Signal Lime #f1ff5c and Keylime Readout #f4ff7d only on metrics, quote marks and named customers on #101013 ground — colour is evidence, and lime marks what was measured.
- Prefix every section eyebrow with "//" in GeistMono 15px at 500, uppercase, 0.3px tracking — it frames each chapter as annotated source code.
- Separate list rows with 1px #e4e4e7 hairlines and 24px vertical padding instead of card boxes — the feature list stays a spec sheet.
- Process all photography into monochrome halftone and frame it in 8px-radius #1a1a1d containers — texture replaces colour as the visual interest.
- Alternate chapters by surface (#ffffff, then #f4f4f5, then #101013) with 120px between sections — tonal shifts carry structure that shadows carry elsewhere.

### Don't
- Don't make lime the CTA fill. A #f1ff5c "Start a free trial" button feels like the obvious brand move, but it collapses the evidence-only rule and turns every page into a highlighter. Lime on actions is never permitted.
- Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons. Even a soft 0 4px 12px shadow contradicts the tonal system, where #1a1a1d on #101013 already provides lift.
- Don't round buttons beyond 4px. A 9999px pill or 12px radius reads consumer SaaS and breaks the 2px, 4px and 8px machined vocabulary.
- Don't set mono in sentence case or at 400 weight. GeistMono must stay 500 and uppercase with 0.02em tracking, or labels drift into terminal output.
- Don't colour the halftone photographs with duotone blues or brand tints. The grayscale image is non-negotiable, because lime is the only hue allowed to sit on top of it.
- Don't bold body copy to create emphasis in quotes. The 44px testimonial shifts from #a1a1aa to #ffffff at weight 400, and bolding it would turn proof into marketing.
- Don't place Keylime Readout #f4ff7d text on #ffffff. It fails contrast, and the accent only reads as a glowing gauge on dark ground.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f4f4f5 (Fog Panel)
- inverted surface: #101013 (Onyx Panel)
- primary text: #000000 (Ink)
- secondary text: #71717a (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #e4e4e7 (Mist Hairline)
- accent: #f1ff5c (Signal Lime)
- primary action: #0a0a0c (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts use the zinc ramp (#0a0a0c, #71717a, #a1a1aa and #e4e4e7) for every series. A single highlighted series or value may appear in Signal Lime #f1ff5c as a solid fill on #101013 ground, or in Keylime Readout #f4ff7d as a mono numeral, and only one lime element is allowed per chart.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #0a0a0c, text #ffffff, a 1px solid #0a0a0c border and border-radius 4px. Use padding 12px 20px for a 50px height and 200px width, GeistSans 16px at weight 400 with line-height 1.5, and no box-shadow. After the label, add an 8px gap and a 16px square chip with background #1a1a1d and radius 2px containing a ↗ glyph in #ffffff. Place a matching secondary button 16px to the right: background #ffffff, text #0a0a0c, 1px solid #ccccd5 border, same padding, radius and font.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff with a 120px top padding and centred content. Add an h1 "Postgres for sensor and machine data" in GeistSans 700, 80px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -2.4px, colour #0a0a0c, max-width 940px. Below it, 24px down, add a GeistSans 400 18px subline at line-height 1.5 in #000000, max-width 680px. Then, 40px down, add the primary and secondary button pair. Below the buttons, 64px down, add a 1440px frame with background #1a1a1d, radius 8px and a monochrome halftone photograph. Pin a #0a0a0c99 strip to its top-left with 20px 24px padding holding three GeistMono 500 15px uppercase stats, values in #f4ff7d and labels in #e4e4e7, 0.3px tracking.

3. Build a feature list: a column of rows, each with a 1px solid #e4e4e7 bottom border, 24px vertical padding and 0px radius. Each row contains a 28px icon tile framed by corner brackets in #ccccd5 holding a 16px line icon in #0a0a0c, then a 24px gap. Next comes a title in GeistSans 600 22px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing -0.22px, colour #101013, with a description 4px below in GeistSans 400 15px, line-height 1.5, colour #000000. Precede the list's companion heading with the eyebrow "// PRIMITIVES" in GeistMono 500 15px, uppercase, 0.3px tracking, colour #000000.

4. Build a navigation bar: a 70px static (not sticky) bar on #ffffff with no border or shadow, content in a 1440px container. Put the logo at left. Then add links "Product, Industry, Docs, Pricing, Developer Hub, Company" in GeistSans 500 15px, colour #0a0a0c, 32px apart. At right add a "Log In" text link, then a secondary button (background #ffffff, 1px solid #ccccd5, radius 4px, padding 10px 16px, GeistSans 400 16px, #0a0a0c), then 8px later a primary button (background #0a0a0c, text #ffffff, radius 4px, padding 10px 16px). Dropdowns open a #ffffff panel with 1px #e4e4e7 column rules and 8px-radius tiles padded 16px, each with a title in 16px at 600 #000000 and a description in 15px at 400 #71717a.

5. Build a dark testimonial block: full-bleed background #101013 split into two columns, with a monochrome halftone photo left. On it, place a metric ticket: a 1px solid #f1ff5c outlined window above a solid #f1ff5c footer with 8px radius and 16px padding, containing "66%" in GeistSans 400 32px and "Monthly savings" in 18px, both #0a0a0c. On the right, add a #f1ff5c quote mark, then a quote in GeistSans 400 44px, line-height 1.25, that begins in #a1a1aa and ends in #ffffff. Then add attribution in GeistMono 500 15px uppercase #ffffff and a customer link in #f4ff7d. Finish with a tag: GeistMono 500 12px uppercase, 1px solid #a1a1aa, radius 2px, padding 4px 6px.

The title is GeistSans 16px at 600 in Ink #000000, and the description is 15px at 400 in Slate Caption #71717a. The page behind dims under a 70% black scrim, which is not a system token (#000000b3). Column headers use 15px uppercase GeistMono. The tile reads as a directory index rather than a promotional flyout.

### Primary Button — Jet (Filled)
**Role:** Start trial, the single action

Ink on paper. The background is Jet Ink #0a0a0c and the text is Paper Canvas #ffffff in GeistSans 16px at 400. The border is 1px in the fill colour, with 4px radius. Padding is 12px 20px for a 50px height and 200px width in the hero, or 10px 16px for 43px in the nav. A trailing 16px ↗ glyph sits in a 2px-radius Carbon Panel #1a1a1d chip (estimated). There is no shadow. A regular-weight label on a near-black fill is the anti-convention signature, because the action is announced by mass, not by colour.

### Secondary Button — Outlined
**Role:** Contact sales, the alternative path

The primary's paper twin. The background is Paper Canvas #ffffff and the text is Jet Ink #0a0a0c in GeistSans 16px at 400, with a 1px Pewter Border #ccccd5 outline and 4px radius. Padding is 12px 20px for 50px in the hero and 10px 16px for 43px in the nav, with no shadow. It always pairs to the right of the primary at identical width, separated by 16px. Matching dimensions exactly while dropping only the fill keeps the pair a ledger entry rather than a hierarchy fight.

### Arrow Text Link
**Role:** Tertiary "Learn how" navigation

A bare inline link. It has no background, Ink #000000 text on light or Paper Canvas #ffffff on Onyx Panel #101013, GeistSans 16px at 600, 6px 0 padding and a 36px tap height. A trailing 16px → glyph sits in a 2px-radius chip filled Slate Caption #71717a (estimated). The 8px radius exists only as a focus-ring shape. Use it for card-level exits where a third button would crowd the page.

### Mono Eyebrow and Industry Tag
**Role:** Section labels and category chips

Code comments set in type. The eyebrow is GeistMono 15px at 500, uppercase, 0.3px tracking, in Ink #000000, prefixed with "//", and sits 24px above a heading. The tag variant ("ENERGY & ENVIRONMENT") is GeistMono 12px at 500, uppercase, 0.24px tracking, with a 1px Ash Rule #a1a1aa border, 2px radius, 4px 6px padding and a transparent fill on dark ground. It turns marketing chapters into annotated source.

### Halftone Photo Frame with Stat Strip
**Role:** Hero evidence panel

The page's signature image. It is a 1440px-wide container on Carbon Panel #1a1a1d with 8px radius and no border or shadow, holding a monochrome halftone-dithered industrial photograph. Pinned top-left is a Jet Glass #0a0a0c99 strip padded 20px 24px. It carries a GeistSans 16px at 600 lead-in in Mist Hairline #e4e4e7 and three GeistMono 15px uppercase stats, with values in Keylime Readout #f4ff7d and labels in Mist Hairline #e4e4e7. The image proves scale, and the lime only labels the measurements.

### Feature Row
**Role:** Capability list with hairline dividers

A spec-sheet line item. It has no background, with a 1px Mist Hairline #e4e4e7 rule beneath each row, 24px vertical padding and 0px radius. A 28px icon tile is framed by corner brackets in Pewter Border #ccccd5, like a camera viewfinder, and sits 24px left of the text. The title is GeistSans 22px at 600 with -0.22px tracking in Onyx Panel #101013, and the description is 15px at 400 in Ink #000000. It reads as documentation rather than marketing cards.

### Metric Ticket — Lime (Accent Outlier)
**Role:** Customer result callout on photography

The system's only coloured object. An upper window is outlined in a 1px Signal Lime #f1ff5c frame over the halftone photo. Below it sits a solid Signal Lime #f1ff5c footer with notched ticket edges, 8px radius and 16px padding (estimated). It holds "66%" in GeistSans 32px at 400 and a label in 18px at 400, both in Jet Ink #0a0a0c, plus a ↗ glyph. Its notches deliberately break the system's rectilinear vocabulary. The lime is allowed here because the ticket carries a measured outcome.

### Testimonial Block — Dark
**Role:** Customer proof on inverted ground

A full-bleed Onyx Panel #101013 split, with photography left and the quote right. A Signal Lime #f1ff5c quote mark sits above GeistSans 44px at 400, line-height 1.25. The sentence starts in Ash Rule #a1a1aa and resolves into Paper Canvas #ffffff for the emphasised phrase. Attribution is GeistMono 15px uppercase, the customer name is a Keylime Readout #f4ff7d link, and the logo tray above is Carbon Panel #1a1a1d with 8px radius. Grey-to-white emphasis replaces bold, so the quote stays quiet and authoritative.

### Partner Badge Card
**Role:** Certification proof tile

A small issued credential. A Jet Ink #0a0a0c header carries a white partner logo, above a Paper Canvas #ffffff footer with centred GeistMono 12px uppercase copy in Ink #000000. The tile has a 1px Jet Ink #0a0a0c border, 2px radius, 8px padding and no shadow. Three badges sit 48px apart on the Fog Panel #f4f4f5 band. The near-sharp corners and stencil caps make them read as equipment certification plates rather than logo soup.

### Chamfered Content Card — Light and Dark
**Role:** Integrations and Enterprise feature panels

A cut-corner slab. The light variant is Paper Canvas #ffffff edged by a 1px Pewter Border #ccccd5 backing that shows through a clip-path. The dark variant is Onyx Panel #101013. Both use 0px radius with 16px chamfers on the top corners, 32px padding, a GeistSans 32px at 600 title with -0.32px tracking, and a 16px at 400 body. Cards sit in two columns 24px apart. The chamfer is a deliberate outlier to the 8px rule, evoking machined hardware rather than app cards.

### Input Field
**Role:** Lead-capture text entry

A plain form well. The background is Paper Canvas #ffffff and the text is Jet Ink #0a0a0c in GeistSans 16px at 400. It has a 1px Ash Rule #a1a1aa border, 4px radius, 12px 16px padding and a 50px height, with no shadow. Checkboxes are 18px with 2px radius and the same border. Ash Rule rather than Pewter Border gives inputs a slightly darker edge than buttons, which signals editability without colour.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep every action button on Jet Ink #0a0a0c or Paper Canvas #ffffff with a 1px #ccccd5 outline at 4px radius — the action is defined by ink density, not hue.
- Set the display at GeistSans 700, 80px, -2.4px tracking and 1.1 leading — the tightened heavy plate is what makes a near-monochrome page feel engineered.
- Spend Signal Lime #f1ff5c and Keylime Readout #f4ff7d only on metrics, quote marks and named customers on #101013 ground — colour is evidence, and lime marks what was measured.
- Prefix every section eyebrow with "//" in GeistMono 15px at 500, uppercase, 0.3px tracking — it frames each chapter as annotated source code.
- Separate list rows with 1px #e4e4e7 hairlines and 24px vertical padding instead of card boxes — the feature list stays a spec sheet.
- Process all photography into monochrome halftone and frame it in 8px-radius #1a1a1d containers — texture replaces colour as the visual interest.
- Alternate chapters by surface (#ffffff, then #f4f4f5, then #101013) with 120px between sections — tonal shifts carry structure that shadows carry elsewhere.

### Don't
- Don't make lime the CTA fill. A #f1ff5c "Start a free trial" button feels like the obvious brand move, but it collapses the evidence-only rule and turns every page into a highlighter. Lime on actions is never permitted.
- Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons. Even a soft 0 4px 12px shadow contradicts the tonal system, where #1a1a1d on #101013 already provides lift.
- Don't round buttons beyond 4px. A 9999px pill or 12px radius reads consumer SaaS and breaks the 2px, 4px and 8px machined vocabulary.
- Don't set mono in sentence case or at 400 weight. GeistMono must stay 500 and uppercase with 0.02em tracking, or labels drift into terminal output.
- Don't colour the halftone photographs with duotone blues or brand tints. The grayscale image is non-negotiable, because lime is the only hue allowed to sit on top of it.
- Don't bold body copy to create emphasis in quotes. The 44px testimonial shifts from #a1a1aa to #ffffff at weight 400, and bolding it would turn proof into marketing.
- Don't place Keylime Readout #f4ff7d text on #ffffff. It fails contrast, and the accent only reads as a glowing gauge on dark ground.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Default page ground, hero, primitives list and light cards |
| 1 | Fog Panel | `#f4f4f5` | Partner band and inset stat tiles — one tonal step for chapter changes |
| 2 | Onyx Panel | `#101013` | Inverted testimonial chapter and the dark Enterprise card |
| 3 | Carbon Panel | `#1a1a1d` | Trays and photo frames sitting on dark ground |
| 4 | Jet Glass | `#0a0a0c99` | Translucent stat strip floating over halftone photography |

## Elevation

- **Third-party floating badge (system outlier, not for product UI):** `0px 0px 5px 0px rgb(128, 128, 128)`
- **Buttons, cards, inputs, nav, menus and photo frames:** `none` — elevation is carried by surface steps from #101013 to #1a1a1d to #0a0a0c99 and by 1px #e4e4e7 or #ccccd5 lines, so the interface feels printed and machined rather than floating.

## Imagery

Imagery is real industrial photography of refineries, factory floors and pipe racks, converted into coarse monochrome halftone dither so it reads like a printed technical manual. No product screenshots appear on the home page. Photos sit in 8px-radius Carbon Panel #1a1a1d frames with no border or shadow, or run full-bleed inside the Onyx Panel #101013 testimonial half. Overlays are Jet Glass #0a0a0c99 strips and the lime ticket, which reads as an augmented-reality readout pinned to equipment. Icons are 1.5px-stroke line glyphs at 16 to 24px, often enclosed in corner-bracket viewfinder frames. There are no gradients, glows or orbs, and the halftone dot is the only texture token. The narrative is real machines measured in real time.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1440px container with 120px between sections. The hero is a centred single column: an 80px headline capped near 940px, an 18px subline at 680px width, and two 200px buttons 16px apart. A grayscale logo row follows ("TRUSTED BY" in mono, six logos with hairline separators), then a full-container halftone frame. The primitives section splits 580px copy left against a hairline list right. The testimonial runs full-bleed on Onyx Panel #101013, the partner band switches to Fog Panel #f4f4f5 with three badges, and two chamfered cards sit in two columns. The nav is static, filled white and 70px tall, with the logo left and actions right. The footer is about 812px tall with multi-column mono-headed link lists. At 375px, use 52px for the display and 60px section gaps. Overall density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f4f4f5 (Fog Panel)
- inverted surface: #101013 (Onyx Panel)
- primary text: #000000 (Ink)
- secondary text: #71717a (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #e4e4e7 (Mist Hairline)
- accent: #f1ff5c (Signal Lime)
- primary action: #0a0a0c (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts use the zinc ramp (#0a0a0c, #71717a, #a1a1aa and #e4e4e7) for every series. A single highlighted series or value may appear in Signal Lime #f1ff5c as a solid fill on #101013 ground, or in Keylime Readout #f4ff7d as a mono numeral, and only one lime element is allowed per chart.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #0a0a0c, text #ffffff, a 1px solid #0a0a0c border and border-radius 4px. Use padding 12px 20px for a 50px height and 200px width, GeistSans 16px at weight 400 with line-height 1.5, and no box-shadow. After the label, add an 8px gap and a 16px square chip with background #1a1a1d and radius 2px containing a ↗ glyph in #ffffff. Place a matching secondary button 16px to the right: background #ffffff, text #0a0a0c, 1px solid #ccccd5 border, same padding, radius and font.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff with a 120px top padding and centred content. Add an h1 "Postgres for sensor and machine data" in GeistSans 700, 80px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -2.4px, colour #0a0a0c, max-width 940px. Below it, 24px down, add a GeistSans 400 18px subline at line-height 1.5 in #000000, max-width 680px. Then, 40px down, add the primary and secondary button pair. Below the buttons, 64px down, add a 1440px frame with background #1a1a1d, radius 8px and a monochrome halftone photograph. Pin a #0a0a0c99 strip to its top-left with 20px 24px padding holding three GeistMono 500 15px uppercase stats, values in #f4ff7d and labels in #e4e4e7, 0.3px tracking.

3. Build a feature list: a column of rows, each with a 1px solid #e4e4e7 bottom border, 24px vertical padding and 0px radius. Each row contains a 28px icon tile framed by corner brackets in #ccccd5 holding a 16px line icon in #0a0a0c, then a 24px gap. Next comes a title in GeistSans 600 22px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing -0.22px, colour #101013, with a description 4px below in GeistSans 400 15px, line-height 1.5, colour #000000. Precede the list's companion heading with the eyebrow "// PRIMITIVES" in GeistMono 500 15px, uppercase, 0.3px tracking, colour #000000.

4. Build a navigation bar: a 70px static (not sticky) bar on #ffffff with no border or shadow, content in a 1440px container. Put the logo at left. Then add links "Product, Industry, Docs, Pricing, Developer Hub, Company" in GeistSans 500 15px, colour #0a0a0c, 32px apart. At right add a "Log In" text link, then a secondary button (background #ffffff, 1px solid #ccccd5, radius 4px, padding 10px 16px, GeistSans 400 16px, #0a0a0c), then 8px later a primary button (background #0a0a0c, text #ffffff, radius 4px, padding 10px 16px). Dropdowns open a #ffffff panel with 1px #e4e4e7 column rules and 8px-radius tiles padded 16px, each with a title in 16px at 600 #000000 and a description in 15px at 400 #71717a.

5. Build a dark testimonial block: full-bleed background #101013 split into two columns, with a monochrome halftone photo left. On it, place a metric ticket: a 1px solid #f1ff5c outlined window above a solid #f1ff5c footer with 8px radius and 16px padding, containing "66%" in GeistSans 400 32px and "Monthly savings" in 18px, both #0a0a0c. On the right, add a #f1ff5c quote mark, then a quote in GeistSans 400 44px, line-height 1.25, that begins in #a1a1aa and ends in #ffffff. Then add attribution in GeistMono 500 15px uppercase #ffffff and a customer link in #f4ff7d. Finish with a tag: GeistMono 500 12px uppercase, 1px solid #a1a1aa, radius 2px, padding 4px 6px.

## Lime Is Evidence

The chromatic discipline is that saturated colour only ever marks a measurement. Signal Lime #f1ff5c and Keylime Readout #f4ff7d appear on a savings percentage, three scale stats, a quote mark and a customer name, all on #101013 or a photograph, and nowhere on the white canvas. Conventional SaaS sites assign the brand hue to buttons. Here the button is #0a0a0c, so the lime stays rare enough to act like a gauge reading. Three things break it: lime CTAs, lime section backgrounds, and lime decorative icons. To extend the system, ask whether the element states a number or a named result. If it does, it may take lime on dark ground. If it does not, it stays inside the zinc ramp from #000000 to #e4e4e7.

## Halftone Not Gradient

The imagery discipline replaces colour and glow with printed texture. Every photograph is industrial, real and dithered into coarse monochrome halftone, then framed at 8px radius on #1a1a1d or run full-bleed on #101013. The convention in developer-database marketing is mesh gradients, neon orbs and isometric illustration. Timescale refuses all three, and the dot pattern becomes the brand's only ornament. Full-colour stock photography, duotone tints, blurred glow backdrops and 3D renders would each break it, because each introduces hue or softness the system does not budget for. To extend it, process new photography through the same halftone filter, keep it grayscale, and let overlays carry information in #0a0a0c99 strips or a single lime ticket.

## Annotated Monochrome

The typographic discipline is a two-voice split. Geist Sans speaks in heavy, tight headlines at 80px/700 and 52px/600 with -0.03em tracking, while Geist Mono annotates in 500-weight uppercase at 12px and 15px with +0.02em tracking and "//" prefixes. Hierarchy comes from a steep scale of about 1.5 per step and from weight, not colour, because nearly all text is #000000, #0a0a0c or #101013. Mixed-case mono, a third typeface, or lime-coloured headings would break it. To extend it, give every new section a mono eyebrow, a sans heading drawn from the scale, and body at 15px or 16px. Reserve the 44px regular weight for voices that are not the company's own.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — The same Geist Sans and Geist Mono pairing on a near-black/white system with 4–6px buttons, though Vercel leans on gradients where Timescale uses halftone photography.
- **ClickHouse** — An analytics database that likewise rations a single acid yellow against black, but ClickHouse spends it on CTAs while Timescale restricts it to metrics.
- **Neon** — A Postgres competitor with a lime-green signal on dark ground and mono technical labels, set in a darker default theme than Timescale's white canvas.
- **PlanetScale** — A database brand with a monochrome palette, hairline-divided feature lists and uppercase mono eyebrows that annotate sections like code.
- **Supabase** — A direct Postgres category peer using 4–6px-radius dark and outline button pairs, with a green accent applied far more liberally across the UI.
